full_judgment: 2. Facts necessary for disposal of this appeal are that the predecessors in-interest of respondent Nos. 1-17 as the plaintiffs filed Title Suit No. 164 of 1991 in the Court of Assistant Judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka for declaration of title in the suit land and also for a declaration that sale deed being No. 8310 dated 09.09.1956 was forged, fraudulent and inoperative on the averment that the suit land along with other lands appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 62 originally belonged to Saddat Bepari who died before the S.A. operation leaving behind his wife, Shamchun Nessa, one son named Shamsul Haque and two daughters named Hajera Khatun and Saleha Khatun as his heirs. Before death, Saddat Bepari transferred the suit land along with other lands in favour of his legal heirs by an oral gift and they were possessing the suit land. During the S.A. operation, the suit land measuring 1.70 acres appertaining to S.A. Plot No. 198 was recorded in the name of the plaintiffs. The plaintiffs have been paying rents regularly and possessing the land in ejmali, From the local Tashil Office, the plaintiffs learned that the defendants got their names mutated in the record on the basis of sale deed dated 19.09.1956 purportedly executed and registered by them in favour of one Hazi Abdul Aziz. The plaintiffs filed Miscellaneous Case No. 230 of 1989-90 before the Assistant Commissioner (Land) for mutation of their names. The case is pending since the title of the plaintiffs in the suit land was clouded because of the deed dated,19.09.1956 created by the defendants and the subsequent deeds on the basis of the said deed, the plaintiffs were compelled to file the suit for the relief aforementioned.
